select m.id, mgm.id as bindingId, m.model_code as modelCode, m.model_name as modelName, m.model_type as modelType, coalesce(mgm.billing_type, m.billing_type) as billingType, coalesce(mgm.prompt_price, m.prompt_price) as promptPrice, coalesce(mgm.cached_prompt_price, m.cached_prompt_price) as cachedPromptPrice, coalesce(mgm.cache_write_prompt_price, m.cache_write_prompt_price) as cacheWritePromptPrice, coalesce(mgm.completion_price, m.completion_price) as completionPrice, coalesce(mgm.request_price, m.request_price) as requestPrice, coalesce(mgm.multiplier, m.multiplier) as multiplier, m.is_public as isPublic, m.status, m.created_at as createdAt, g.id as groupId, g.group_code as groupCode, g.group_name as groupName, p.id as providerId, p.provider_name as providerName, p.provider_type as providerType, r.upstream_model as upstreamModel from models m left join model_group_models mgm on mgm.model_id = m.id left join model_groups g on g.id = mgm.group_id and g.status = 'ACTIVE' left join model_routes r on r.model_id = m.id and r.status = 'ACTIVE' left join providers p on p.id = r.provider_id
where m.deleted = 0
where m.deleted = 0 and m.status = 'ACTIVE' and m.is_public = 1
order by g.id asc, m.id desc

select p.id, p.provider_name as providerName, p.base_url as baseUrl, p.provider_type as providerType, p.timeout_ms as timeoutMs, t.token_value_encrypted as tokenValueEncrypted from providers p join provider_tokens t on t.provider_id = p.id and t.deleted = 0 and t.status = 'ACTIVE' where p.id = #{providerId} and p.deleted = 0 and p.status = 'ACTIVE' order by t.weight_no desc, t.id asc limit 1

select m.id as modelId, m.model_code as modelCode from model_routes r join models m on m.id = r.model_id where r.provider_id = #{providerId} and r.upstream_model = #{upstreamModel} and r.status = 'ACTIVE' and m.deleted = 0 order by m.id asc limit 1
